## Minimally Reproducible Test Case 1. Celery beat with Django database scheduler is used. Django timezone and celery timezone are both set to Europe/Vilnius. Current time is 2025-05-20 8:50 Europe/Vilnius. 2. Database schedule is changed to a time around 8:40 every day UTC, which is 11:40 Europe/Vilnius 3. Celery beat starts spamming the task as fast as it can

# Expected Behavior I expect the crontab schedule to run at 8:40 UTC once. # Actual Behavior The issue lies within the remaining function in time.py and ffwd.__radd__ method. crontab.remaining_delta returns last_run_at time in Europe/Vilnius timezone, delta in crontab's UTC timezone and now in Europe/Vilnius again. Everything is passed to remaining where end_date = start + ends_in. This triggers ffwd.__radd__ which replaces hour and minute with the values from crontab schedule which is in a different timezone. A concrete example for remaining call: start is datetime.datetime(2025, 5, 20, 9, 26, 8, 224490, tzinfo=datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(seconds=10800))) ends_in is ffwd(hour=8, minute=40, second=0, microsecond=0, weeks=0) (8:40 is in UTC in the crontab schedule, not UTC + 3 hours) end_date is computed as datetime.datetime(2025, 5, 20, 8, 40, tzinfo=datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(seconds=10800))), which should actually either be 8:40 UTC or 11:40 Europe/Vilnius. This makes celery beat think that the cron is already due and keeps scheduling it every few milliseconds. The stack trace of the remaining call `````remaining, time.py:225 remaining_estimate, schedules.py:639 is_due, tzcrontab.py:45 is_due, schedulers.py:136 populate_heap, beat.py:314 tick, beat.py:340 start, beat.py:644 start_scheduler, beat.py:113 run, beat.py:84 beat, beat.py:72 caller, base.py:135 new_func, decorators.py:33 invoke, core.py:783 invoke, core.py:1434 invoke, core.py:1688 main, core.py:1078 __call__, core.py:1157 main, celery.py:231 main, __main__.py:15 , celery:8``` ffwd currently has no support for timezones, so changing ffwd.__radd__ is not possible, so I believe that crontab.remaining_delta should construct ffwd objects in local timezone rather than crontab timezone.
